clips.title: The story
paras: In southwestern Stonetalon, flames and smoke consume the Charred Vale. The Venture Company's logging left a once thriving woodland in ruins, where fire elementals roam and Bloodfury harpies guard their territory.

The Charred Vale was once a thriving woodland in a basin of southwestern Stonetalon. Majestic treants guarded it, while native chimaeras and harpies made their home among the trees. The Venture Company brought the ruin. Its goblins clear-cut the forest with explosive machinery, corrupting the treants and waking chaotic fire elementals. The treants eventually drove the goblins back, but the loggers left the land broken and scarred by fire. Whatever foul devices they used as they retreated also tainted the valley.

Blackened ancients wander blindly through smoke and ash, among enraged elementals. Bloodfury harpies roost in skeletal snags and defend what remains of their territory. Druids from Sun Rock Retreat refuse to abandon the valley. They send travelers to sow enchanted seeds and tend the corrupted ancients as they work to reclaim the scorched earth.
